# Fit met Levi

> Fit met Levi is the public coaching site of Levi Otte, persoonlijk coach in Roosdaal, België (Zavelstraat 19, 1760). Legal / social handle: FitLeViBe. Domain: https://fitlevibe.com

Levi coaches lifestyle — training, nutrition, mindset — since 2015. Public line: 20% workout, 80% nutrition, 100% mindset. Making you healthier and happier. Google reviews around 5/5.

## Do not confuse
- Public site name: **Fit met Levi** (person: **Levi Otte**). Do not lead with the coined brand FitLeViBe.
- Levi is an **independent Herbalife member**. This is not herbalife.com and not an official Herbalife website. No income claims. No medical or guaranteed weight-loss claims.
- FitCheck is a free lifestyle-coaching conversation (name, Belgian mobile, goal). Not medical advice. Not card payments.
